deliverable: Five independent high-fidelity designs for the same Fouc project workbench HOMEPAGE only
mode: built-in image_gen; ui-mockup; new generation grounded in an existing shell reference
scope: Design the landing page reached by 工作台 in the existing sidebar. Do not design a feature-detail, document editor, batch execution or review page. Do not generate a multi-screen board.
reference_role: Actual Fouc shell geometry, navigation, typography and material only. Replace the old dashboard content. Image is 1773x1108; do not enlarge all controls when composing a roughly 1600x1000 image.

density.target_frame: approximately 1600x1000, ordinary 100 percent desktop product scale
density.sidebar: 272px, approximately 17 percent of the output width, never 320px
density.content_frame: single white main surface with 16px outside corners and a fine border
density.page_toolbar: ONE compact 44-48px row; no breadcrumbs, stacked title/description/status/tabs/filter bands
density.content_start: around y96; no huge hero pushing core work below half the viewport

shell_text.system_controls: history arrows, active 工作台 tab, add tab, search, task, Windows window controls; same silhouettes and geometry

home_job: Resume the exact useful place in an ongoing work item, with a precise next action.
Surface one or two decisions or independent reviews that actually need the person.
Locate the other current-project work without exposing every workflow tool.
Offer one compact 新建工作 entry; details are requested after entry, not all on the homepage.
add_semantics: Ten activities are a flexible revisitable pool, not ten mandatory columns or a progress percentage.
Stage, role, skill, run status and evidence gate are different concepts.
Homepage labels a work item's current activity and next action, then routes to dedicated pages.
Gates require evidence, version and the responsible confirmer; do not approve from a bare homepage checkbox.
Research and writing are valid work types. Bug fixing can start at reproduction.
Project remains the sole business scope. No workspace entity or extra project chooser. No knowledge-base or automation module.

constraints: One real application screenshot per concept. No collage, marketing board, device frame, tilted perspective or external title.
This must look like a project homepage: show multiple work items or project-wide resumption/attention. Never a single feature's editor or code diff.
The five concepts must differ in content hierarchy AND visual composition, not the same layout with different titles.
No huge greeting, poster typography, KPI wall, decorative chart, permanent chat pane, giant command box, or every feature advertised at once.
Professional studio-level craftsmanship from typography, fine rules, strong alignment, deliberate spacing, material and coherent work content.
Neutral global navigation and actions; use color sparingly for actual workflow type, status, warning, success and content links.
Keep resource cards flat, single-border and crisp; no stacked shadows or excessive nesting. Do not draw UI icons by hand. Match current FA7 icon shapes.
All illustrated tasks, counts, people and results are sample UX content, not current implementation or execution evidence.

editorial.name: 编辑简报
editorial.style: A premium editorial daily brief: off-white/white paper, graphite typography, fine horizontal rules, asymmetric proportions, small carefully aligned metadata; no giant headline and no grid of dashboards.
editorial.composition: A dominant resume-work spread on the left: current work and the exact place to continue, with a small meaningful excerpt from design v3. A narrow right margin holds two needs-human items. Below the main spread, a compact ledger of other ongoing work and a single short change note. Main object and reading rhythm lead; distinct hierarchy rather than equal-sized cards.

ledger.name: 精密台账
ledger.style: Refined professional engineering ledger: crisp cool-neutral white, hairline table structure, disciplined 13px typography, small monospaced IDs and timestamps, aligned columns and nuanced state chips; flat, confident and high precision.
ledger.composition: The homepage is one broad grouped work register with six current work rows: work name, current activity, exact next action, responsible person and update. Human attention is indicated in the relevant row with restrained amber, not a second dashboard. A lightweight selected-row context strip underneath gives the next action and source references; it is not a permanent side inspector or an editor. No three-column layout, no card grid.

desk.name: 工作桌面
desk.style: A crafted contemporary software work desk: precise flat document-preview cards, subtle white/gray material, thin crisp edges, small workflow-color accents, carefully cropped real content previews, compact metadata and human presence. Sophisticated, tactile but not 3D or decorative.
desk.composition: A concise human-attention ribbon is part of the first content row. Below, an asymmetric collection of four ongoing work surfaces: one wide active design card with a small real document excerpt; a smaller debugging card with reproduction steps; a research card with three findings; a writing card with an outline fragment. Cards are entry points to different work, not editors. Low at the bottom are two recent updates as a compact text row. An updated document or submitted finding is not a completed delivery. No permanent side panel, no equal KPI tiles.

nocturne.name: 深色指挥台
nocturne.style: Use Fouc's EXISTING dark theme, not a new colorful theme: shell #111111, sidebar #141414, main panel #181818, elevated #222222, text #ededed, secondary #a3a3a3, borders rgba(237,237,237,.14). Same exact geometry and icons as light reference. Elegant matte graphite, extremely restrained amber/green/blue, no neon, no sci-fi effects.
nocturne.composition: Human-attention first: two well-designed decision/review rows dominate the upper left, each with context and a precise entry action. Under them a concise list of four other ongoing work items. A slim right rail shows three Agent tasks with their actual state, latest meaningful result and appropriate controls; waiting for review is not running. Full logs and chat are hidden. A quiet recent-update row anchors the bottom; a submitted fix is not a completed delivery. Do not become an all-metrics monitoring dashboard.

tempo.name: 交付航线
tempo.style: Swiss planning studio: white surface, exact fine-line grid, restrained graphite hierarchy, small schedule typography, elegant thin today marker, selected work with tiny semantic colors. Architectural and calm, not a colorful calendar or enormous Gantt chart.
tempo.composition: A project-level weekly work trajectory is the dominant plane, Mon Nov9 to Sun Nov15 2026, Today Thu Nov12. Four work rows show near-term confirmed delivery/checkpoint events rather than ten stages. Current work names stay at a fixed left baseline; selected row points to an actual upcoming review. A short lower action band contains the next two human checkpoints and a small resume entry. No right side inspector, no KPI wall, no enormous calendar header or duplicate date tabs.
